name: (Goofy) Playercontroller for a grappling hook game!
author: CookieDoughDev
description: Here's a small test/project I was working on a while ago! I made this for a platformer game to try out the concept of a player having a grappling hook to navigate throughout the map. It's kinda goofy, but let me know if you'd like me to continue this project. ;)     (OBS: Forgot to say, press R to restart!)
